name: Star Defender
description: A neon space shooter: drag your ship, blast waves of enemies, collect upgrades and beat the bosses.
prompt: A vertical space shooter with a ship I drag, auto fire, enemy types that zigzag, shoot or take many hits, waves, a boss every five waves, shield and weapon upgrades and a best score.
